title: OpenSpec tools live in the core plugin
what: Move kit packet and kit spec-check, which only serve OpenSpec, from the core plugin into the openspec plugin, so core carries nothing spec-specific.
why: Proposed by the OpenSpec design (reports/design-openspec.md rev 2, 24 Oct) as a LOW follow-up, after the owner's decision that spec writing is an opt-in method beside relay's own cycle.
failing_case: plugins/core/lib/kit_packet.py and kit_spec_check.py are OpenSpec tools in core (design, facts list).
pass_cases: core has no OpenSpec-only code; kit packet and kit spec-check work from the openspec plugin; their tests pass.
